posts.topic: Amity Announces $100 Million Series D Funding

slide1.headline: Amity Announces $100 Million Series D Funding
slide1.subtitle: Thai AI Startup Expands Operations

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 25 Mar 2026
Amity, a Thai AI startup, has announced a $100 million Series D funding round.
The funding will be used to expand the company's operations.
Amity has also launched an R&D center in Singapore.
The company's valuation is expected to increase significantly.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will enable Amity to enhance its AI capabilities.
The company's expansion into Singapore will increase its presence in the region.
The R&D center will drive innovation in the AI space.
Amity's growth is expected to have a positive impact on the AI industry.

The R&D center will drive innovation and growth in the AI industry.
